entries.name: LibreTranslate
entries.description: Open-source LibreTranslate engine translating text between supported languages, served pay-per-call over x402 (available via the MemoryAPI and HTTPay gateways).

usage.callShape: GET https://httpay.xyz/api/translate?text=<text>&source=<lang>&target=<lang> (NOT POST — POST returns 404). x402 on Base, quote $0.003.
usage.outputShape: BROKEN: response is 200 but body is {error, detail, meta} — never returns a translation. Working shape would be body.translatedText but it is never produced.
quirks: Registry CALL method (POST) is WRONG: POST /api/translate returns 404 'Cannot POST /api/translate' (no charge).
The x402 402 schema declares input.method enum [GET,HEAD,DELETE]; correct method is GET with query params.
Param name is ?text= NOT ?q= (paying with ?q= returns 200 {error:'Missing ?text= parameter'} and STILL charges $0.003).
priceDisplay 'Free' is wrong — endpoint quotes $0.003 USDC on Base (3000 atomic units).

BACKEND DEAD: gateway forwards to upstream LibreTranslate which returns HTTP 400 'Visit https://portal.libretranslate.com to get an API key'. The gateway has no upstream key, so it charges but can never translate.
Returns HTTP 200 even on failure — the real error is inside body.error/body.detail, so status code is not a reliable success signal.
usage.guide: Do NOT use this endpoint — it is broken and will charge you ($0.003 USDC on Base) without translating. The correct call is GET https://httpay.xyz/api/translate?text=hello&source=en&target=es (POST 404s; param is text not q), but the upstream LibreTranslate instance behind the gateway demands its own API key the gateway does not supply, so every paid call returns HTTP 200 with body {error:'LibreTranslate returned HTTP 400', detail:'...get an API key'} and no translation. Skip it.

quirks: Method is GET, NOT POST — POST to /text/translate returns 404 'Cannot POST /text/translate'.
Costs ~$0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (registry previously listed POST + Free — both WRONG).
Param names are 'text' and 'to' — NOT MyMemory's q/langpair, and NOT this sibling /nlp/translate's q/source/target. Wrong names return 400 with hint '?text=... required, optional &to=lang'.
Source language is auto-detected (no 'from' param); returned as source_lang.

Payment verified via live 402 probe 2026-06-11 (Base USDC).
usage.guide: Translate text between languages via x402node's own translation API. Auto-detects source language if not specified. entries.name: x402node Translate (NLP / MyMemory)
entries.description: Translate text between languages via MyMemory (free upstream, 50+ languages). Returns the translation, a match-quality score, and alternative candidate translations. Distinct endpoint from /text/translate with different param and output conventions.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/nlp/translate?q=<text>&source=<src-or-auto>&target=<langcode> (x402 paid on Base, ~$0.008/call). Params in query string.
usage.outputShape: source (code), target (code), original (string echo), translated (string), match_quality (number 0-1), alternatives[] (each: text, quality, segment), _hint (string promo)
quirks: Method is GET, NOT POST (registry previously listed POST + Free — both WRONG). Costs ~$0.008 USDC via x402 on Base.
Param names are 'q', 'source', 'target' — DIFFERENT from sibling /text/translate which uses 'text'/'to'. Use source=auto for auto-detect.
MyMemory-backed: returns an 'alternatives' array of candidate translations with per-candidate quality scores (0-100) and the matched segment.
Output field names are original/translated/match_quality/alternatives — different from the /text/translate sibling (text_in/text_out).
More expensive than /text/translate ($0.008 vs $0.005) for arguably the same task; choose /text/translate unless you need MyMemory alternatives/match quality.

Distinct endpoint from /text/translate with different param and output conventions. entries.description: Translate text between languages with automatic source-language detection, returning the translation and a confidence score, billed per call via x402.

entries.name: cn402 Chinese Converter (Simplified -> Traditional)
entries.description: Convert Simplified Chinese text to Traditional Chinese (Taiwan standard). OpenCC-style GB->BIG5 / mainland->Taiwan Hanzi conversion.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.cn402.com/hanzi/s2t?text=<urlencoded simplified chinese> — x402 v1 paid, ~$0.0022 USDC on Base. NO request body; text is a URL query param. NO POST (POST 404s).
usage.outputShape: body.input (echoed input), body.output (converted traditional text), body.mode = 'simplified->traditional', body._hint (provider marketing string)
quirks: x402 v1 format: the 402 challenge advertises maxAmountRequired 2200 (=$0.0022 USDC) on Base, asset USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0x4466d4A84b7c49a6A094ec6eef4a0712D6dd125e. agentcash MCP fetch CANNOT pay this (errors parse_payment_required 'x402 v1 not supported, only v2 with accepts array'); use an x402 v1-capable payer.
Method is GET-only. Registry/probe historically said POST, but POST returns 404 'Cannot POST /hanzi/s2t' with NO payment taken.
Input text is a URL query param ?text=<urlencoded>, NOT a JSON body.

Some characters are identical across Simplified/Traditional, so output can equal input for such strings; body.mode confirms the direction was applied. Use chars that differ (e.g. 国->國) to see a change.
Result text is in body.output (not body.result/data).
